vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Okay — what's the first step?"
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a limp telling A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about Carolina. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You give A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
📓 Journal: Carolina taught the woman in her 40s, with a scarred cheek Wound Care.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek claps your shoulder. "You're doing better than you think." (+15 energy — morale is real.)

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling A woman, maybe 30s about Rebecca. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"
👂 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek "Hey — come here. You should hear this."
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek presses something into your hand. "Lotus Root — for what you did. Look for the leaves. You'll know it."
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — Catalina telling A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about Liam. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek showed Catalina the Lotus Root — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Better close to the fire today.
You catch fragments by the fire — Mia telling A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about you. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
📋 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 2 sticks. The pile grows. (6 sticks now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s telling Catalina about A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
You catch fragments by the fire — Mia telling Rebecca about A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s telling Ingrid about A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s telling Liam about A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Better close to the fire today.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
📓 Journal: Ingrid taught the woman in her 40s, with a scarred cheek Herbal Medicine.
📋 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek sets out to find Rebecca. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling Mia about herself. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
✅ You saw the creek. A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
🛡️ Carolina, Arnold, Lungile, Tom and Quinn met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Carolina, Arnold, Lungile, Tom, Quinn are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Carolina, Palesa, Lungile, Tom and Ingrid met them at the door — 5 put down. Carolina, Palesa, Lungile, Tom, Ingrid are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lungile just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carolina just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tom just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carolina, Lungile, Tom, Ingrid and Quinn met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Carolina, Lungile, Ingrid, Quinn are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Palesa just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
